spec.description:
Bradford Polymax thermal and acoustic polyester insulation is
manufactured from 100% thermally bonded polyester fibres containing up to 80%
recycled content. Specifically engineered for walls and partitions in
residential and commercial buildings, it provides non-irritant, easy-to-install
thermal and acoustic performance. It contains no chemical binders or added flame
retardants, will not pack down or deteriorate, and is approved by the National
Asthma Council's Sensitive Choice program.
features:
100% thermally
bonded polyester fibre with no chemical binders

Made from up to 80% recycled
PET fibres

Non-irritant and completely safe to touch without protective
gear

Approved by National Asthma Council Australia's Sensitive
Choice program
Resistant to moisture, mould, rot, and vermin

install:
Ensure stud cavity is clean and electrical services are roughed in prior to
installing insulation

Friction-fit Polymax batts snugly between timber or
steel wall framing studs

Ensure batts fit tightly against studs, top plates,
and bottom plates without gaps or sagging

Avoid excessive compression of
batts to preserve rated thermal thickness

Cut or slit neatly around
electrical wiring, nogging, and plumbing using a sharp utility knife or shears
Install external wall wraps or internal plasterboard linings over framed batts
selection_checklist:
Confirm framing stud spacing (430mm for 450mm
centres, 580mm for 600mm centres)

Select
required thermal R-value (R1.5, R2.0, or R2.5) to comply with NCC / NatHERS
energy rating

Confirm non-combustibility requirements (polyester is
combustible; if AS 1530.1 non-combustible is mandated, specify glasswool)
Check allergy and sensitive household requirements
accessories: Bradford Thermoseal or Enviroseal wall wrap

Serrated insulation knife or
heavy-duty shears
limitations:
Not non-combustible under AS 1530.1; do
not use where non-combustible insulation is required by NCC

Do not compress
into stud cavities shallower than the nominal thickness

Indoor/enclosed wall
application only; protect from weather and wet conditions

use_cases:
Insulating external
timber-frame walls in new residential builds for thermal control without itchy
glasswool fibres

Acoustic and thermal partition insulation in internal walls
of asthma and allergy-sensitive homes

Mid-floor acoustic and thermal infill
between ground and first-floor living spaces
not_for:
Commercial
fire-rated wall assemblies requiring AS 1530.1 non-combustibility

Exposed
outdoor cladding without external lining

Flooring underlay subject to direct
mechanical foot traffic
retrieval.rag_summary:
Bradford Polyester - Polymax is a
premium, itch-free thermal and acoustic insulation batt manufactured from 100%
thermally bonded polyester fibres with up to 80% recycled content. Engineered
for 90mm timber and steel stud wall cavities, it delivers thermal ratings from
R1.5 to R2.5 and sound dampening without chemical binders or added flame
retardants. Recognized by Sensitive Choice as asthma- and allergy-friendly and
backed by a 70-year performance warranty, it provides a safe, non-irritant
alternative to glasswool for residential walls and mid-floors.
